To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the elastic scattering amplitude is phase dependent, and this dependence influences the profiles of elastic scattering, and this effect can be used as a probe for the phase dependence of the amplitude.

the elastic amplitude is not only a function of the impact parameter, but also a function of the scattering angle, that this angle-dependence is due to the influence of the nuclear potential on the wave function of the projectile and that it can be described by the Glauber approximation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the phase of the high-energy elastic hadron scattering amplitude.
the study of the high energy elastic scattering in the impact parameter representation.
the problem of high-energy hadron scattering in a wide range of impact parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the phase-dependence of the high-energy elastic amplitude is a real physical effect and it has to be taken into account when the analysis of the elastic scattering data is carried out.
the peripheral nature of high-energy elastic scattering is well established and the phase of high-energy elastic amplitude is a well-defined physical quantity.
the phase dependence of high energy elastic cross sections is a peripheral effect.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase of the high-energy elastic amplitude is a very sensitive tool for the investigation of the hadron interaction at high energies.
the phase of the scattering amplitude is a very sensitive quantity and that it can be determined with high accuracy.
in high-energy elastic hadron scattering the phase dependence of the scattering amplitude is the most important factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in the framework of our approach, the interference effects can be explained in the framework of the peripheral model.
it is possible to describe the high-energy hadron scattering in a wide energy range by a simple model of the hadron as a composite object.
the phase of the elastic amplitude is a physical observable.
